001package io.jstach.rainbowgum;
002
003import java.net.URI;
004import java.nio.file.Paths;
005import java.util.List;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import java.util.Optional;
009import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
010import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantLock;
011
012import io.jstach.rainbowgum.LogOutput.OutputProvider;
013import io.jstach.rainbowgum.output.ListLogOutput;
014
015/**
016 * Register output providers by URI scheme.
017 */
018public sealed interface LogOutputRegistry extends OutputProvider permits DefaultOutputRegistry {
019
020        /**
021         * The URI scheme for list provider.
022         */
023        public static String LIST_OUTPUT_SCHEME = "list";
024
025        /**
026         * Register a provider by {@link URI#getScheme() scheme}.
027         * @param scheme URI scheme to match for.
028         * @param provider provider for scheme.
029         */
030        public void register(String scheme, OutputProvider provider);
031
032        /**
033         * Finds an output by name.
034         * @param name output name.
035         * @return maybe an output.
036         */
037        Optional<LogOutput> output(String name);
038
039        /**
040         * Attempts to reopen all outputs of a certain type usually for log rotation. This
041         * call will block if it attempts to reopen. If reopening is already happening an
042         * empty list will be returned.
043         * @return alert events for outputs that failed to reopen, or an empty list if
044         * reopening was skipped or every output reopened successfully.
045         */
046        public List<LogEvent> reopen();
047
048        /**
049         * Attempts to flush all outputs usually for log rotation. This call will block if it
050         * attempts to flush. If flush is already happening an empty list will be returned.
051         * @return alert events for outputs that failed to flush, or an empty list if flushing
052         * was skipped or every output flushed successfully.
053         */
054        public List<LogEvent> flush();
055
056}
057
058final class DefaultOutputRegistry implements LogOutputRegistry {
059
060        private final Map<String, LogOutput> outputs = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
061
062        private final Map<String, OutputProvider> providers = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
063
064        private final ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry;
065
066        private final ReentrantLock reopenLock = new ReentrantLock();
067
068        static LogOutputRegistry of(ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
069                var r = new DefaultOutputRegistry(serviceRegistry);
070                for (var p : StandardLogOutputProvider.values()) {
071                        r.register(p.scheme(), p);
072                }
073                return r;
074        }
075
076        public DefaultOutputRegistry(ServiceRegistry serviceRegistry) {
077                this.serviceRegistry = serviceRegistry;
078        }
079
080        @Override
081        public List<LogEvent> reopen() {
082                return requestIO(LogAction.StandardAction.REOPEN);
083        }
084
085        @Override
086        public List<LogEvent> flush() {
087                return requestIO(LogAction.StandardAction.FLUSH);
088        }
089
090        private List<LogEvent> requestIO(LogAction action) {
091                if (reopenLock.tryLock()) {
092                        try {
093                                return _request(action);
094                        }
095                        finally {
096                                reopenLock.unlock();
097                        }
098                }
099                else {
100                        return List.of();
101                }
102        }
103
104        private List<LogEvent> _request(LogAction action) {
105                /*
106                 * TODO check rainbowgum is actually running.
107                 */
108                return Actor.act(serviceRegistry.find(LogAppender.class).stream().map(a -> InternalLogAppender.of(a)).toList(),
109                                action);
110        }
111
112        @Override
113        public void register(String scheme, OutputProvider provider) {
114                providers.put(scheme, provider);
115        }
116
117        private LogOutput _register(String name, LogOutput output) {
118                if (outputs.putIfAbsent(name, output) != null) {
119                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Name is already in use. name = '%s'".formatted(name));
120                }
121                return output;
122        }
123
124        @Override
125        public Optional<LogOutput> output(String name) {
126                return Optional.ofNullable(outputs.get(name));
127        }
128
129        private static URI normalize(URI uri) {
130                String scheme = uri.getScheme();
131                String path = uri.getPath();
132                String query = uri.getRawQuery();
133                if (scheme == null) {
134                        if (path == null) {
135                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("URI is not proper: " + uri);
136                        }
137                        if (path.startsWith("./")) {
138                                uri = Paths.get(path).toUri();
139                        }
140                        else {
141                                uri = URI.create(path + ":///");
142                        }
143                }
144                else if (scheme.equals("file")) {
145                        if (path.startsWith("/./")) {
146                                path = path.substring(1);
147                        }
148                        uri = Paths.get(path).toUri();
149                        if (query != null) {
150                                uri = URI.create(uri.toString() + "?" + query);
151                        }
152                }
153                return uri;
154        }
155
156        private static LogProviderRef normalize(LogProviderRef ref) {
157                var uri = normalize(ref.uri());
158                return new DefaultLogProviderRef(uri, ref.keyOrNull());
159        }
160
161        @Override
162        public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
163                ref = normalize(ref);
164                var uri = ref.uri();
165                String scheme = Objects.requireNonNull(uri.getScheme());
166                OutputProvider customProvider = providers.get(scheme);
167                if (customProvider == null) {
168                        throw LogProviderRef.NotFoundException.of(ProviderModule.ComponentType.OUTPUT, scheme, uri);
169                }
170                var _ref = ref;
171                return (name, config) -> {
172                        return _register(name, customProvider.provide(_ref).provide(name, config));
173                };
174        }
175
176        enum StandardLogOutputProvider implements LogOutput.OutputProvider {
177
178                STDOUT {
179                        @Override
180                        public LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties) {
181                                return new StdOutOutput();
182                        }
183
184                        @Override
185                        public String scheme() {
186                                return LogOutput.STDOUT_SCHEME;
187                        }
188
189                },
190                STDERR {
191                        @Override
192                        public LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties) {
193                                return new StdErrOutput();
194                        }
195
196                        @Override
197                        public String scheme() {
198                                return LogOutput.STDERR_SCHEME;
199                        }
200
201                },
202                LIST {
203                        @Override
204                        public LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties) {
205                                return new ListLogOutput();
206                        }
207
208                        @Override
209                        public String scheme() {
210                                return LIST_OUTPUT_SCHEME;
211                        }
212
213                };
214
215                @Override
216                public LogProvider<LogOutput> provide(LogProviderRef ref) {
217                        return (s, c) -> {
218                                return provide(ref, s, c.properties());
219                        };
220                }
221
222                public abstract LogOutput provide(LogProviderRef ref, String name, LogProperties properties);
223
224                public abstract String scheme();
225
226        }
227
228}
